name: vanflow-prototipo
description: Protótipo funcional da VanFlow, 100% offline depois do npm install.

scripts.demo: npm run build -w @vanflow/web && npm run start -w @vanflow/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @vanflow/server" "npm run dev -w @vanflow/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
